verdict.rationale: Cua is computer-use agent infrastructure, so how it locates UI elements is a fair question to ask. However, no evidence item documents its approach: there is nothing on accessibility trees, OCR, set-of-marks or coordinate grounding. The only related item is a community report of the agent typing in the wrong place, which shows a misclick happened but says nothing about how elements are located or how to debug it.

support.subject: As a developer, the approach to locating UI elements (accessibility tree, OCR, set-of-marks, coordinates) is documented, so misclicks are debuggable
